title: Capture plumbing: counters on AppState, one bounded-thread primitive, per-call-site limit tests, cheap refusals before captures
outcome:
Structural notes from the tm-5gi4 phase 1 review pair on input c6140c01 (Claude notes) and Opus's own list (2026-09-27; landed as acd7740).

1. acceptance_source_captures_live and engram_turn_basis_captures_live live in StateInner, so each capture takes the state mutex only to clone an Arc (src/state.rs around line 1440). They are runtime-only and belong on AppState, next to its other runtime handles.
2. bounded_content_revision_capture repeats the worker-counting thread pattern of EngramCapture::spawn in engram_turn_checks.rs. Merge them into one bounded-thread primitive.
3. The primitive's limit and panic behaviour are tested, but not that each call site uses its intended limit: 4 for acceptance, 32 for turns.
4. Cheap refusals before captures. The submit-time recapture (up to the 20 s freeze budget, reading the whole worktree) runs before acceptance_evaluation_cli_args and validate_acceptance_evaluation_command_size (src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs around line 983). Likewise, the request-time capture runs before the check for an already active evaluator. Build and validate the arguments, and check the evaluator, first; capture last.
